patch_description: Replace the random point placement with a numerical optimizer. Since the metric is (dmin/dmax)^2, we can normalize scale each iteration so dmax=1 and run gradient ascent on a soft-min of squared pairwise distances (log-sum-exp surrogate with annealing). We seed from several structured 14-point configurations (cube vertices + face centers, hexagonal prism + axis points, icosahedron + poles, random) and keep the best result over restarts, making it deterministic via fixed seeds.
